profile.headline: Forward Deployed Software Engineer at Palantir Technologies

positions.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Washington, District of Columbia, United States

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I assist 12 students with the 3-hour weekly Foundations of Computer Science Lab, during which students complete small projects in Python. I also host individual tutoring for 2 hours a week. My duties include explaining computer science concepts and quickly debugging other's Python code.

positions.title: Genetics Peer Learning Assistant
positions.description: Through this role, I spent two hours a week tutoring students taking the Genetics course. In addition to answering homework questions and reviewing class materials, I assembled practice tests for students to work through before exams.

positions.title: PATH Intern
positions.description: As a Forward Deployed Software Engineering intern, I work to understand customers’ pain points and design end-to-end solutions to address them. These solutions range from high-level system design and prototyping to application development and data integration.

positions.title: Staff Singer
positions.description: As a 1st Soprano staff singer, I attend a weekly rehearsal and perform during Sunday Eucharist as well as other major church events.

company.name: Broad Institute of MIT and Harvard

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description: I worked with Dr. Sriraam Natarajan to create Bayesian Networks modeling 16 heart disease risk factors using data from the CARDIA study. This experience gave me exposure to a variety of machine learning techniques, which I applied in Python and R. I became especially familiar with search-and-score algorithms for Bayesian Network structure learning and the scoring metrics associated with these algorithms. This research experience also enhanced my presentation skills; I wrote an academic paper and created a poster that won second place at the Summer Research Colloquium.

positions.title: Staff Writer
positions.description: The Profile is a monthly news-magazine at Hendrix College. The content I created focused on alumni news and seasonal student activities. This job strengthened both my written and verbal communication skills. Many of my stories were built using hours of interviews with students and alumni.

positions.title: Event Specialist
positions.description: I increased sales and customer satisfaction through product samples, coupon distribution, and other forms of consumer engagement.
